# `/machine-identity-metadata` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /machine-identity-metadata/v1/subtypes

`listMachineIdentitySubtypesV1` — List machine identity subtypes — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns the machine identity subtypes available in the tenant. The list includes **Application** and **Device**. When agentic identity governance is enabled for the tenant, the list also includes **AI Agent**. When Machine Identity Security is not enabled for the tenant, this API returns `404`.

- Scopes: idn:identity:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK
- Returns 200: array of string
